dogecoin.text: Bitcoin itself traded above $64,000 for the first time overnight, while DogeCoin, the digital currency that started as a joke and has been touted aggressively by Elon Musk in recent months, rose 75% (sic) with no obvious price trigger.

Coinbase goes public as Bitcoin, DogeCoin hit new heights
